footerTag: Your cluster, in plain sight. Answers, not objects.

pages.title: kute - Modern Kubernetes TUI
pages.description: kute is a modern Kubernetes TUI that makes a cluster's actual state visible without digging — the broken thing sorts to the top, every action shows the command it will run first, and nothing goes blank when the connection drops. Reads Helm releases and Flux CD reconcilers without either binary installed. Try it in one command, no cluster needed.
pages.ogDescription: Your cluster, in plain sight. Modern Kubernetes TUI. Try kute --demo — no cluster needed.
pages.twitterDescription: Modern Kubernetes TUI. Your cluster, in plain sight.

pages.title: Guide — using kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: How to drive kute: getting started, jumping between resources with the palettes, diagnosing a failing pod, following logs, changing a workload safely, reading a Flux GitOps chain, production safeguards, configuration, and the full keyboard reference.
pages.ogTitle: Guide — using kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: From your first screen to a production delete — how to drive kute, with recordings you can follow along with.
pages.twitterDescription: From your first screen to a production delete — how to drive kute.

pages.title: Install kute — the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: Install kute on macOS, Linux or Windows: one binary, nothing added to your cluster. Package managers, what you need before you start, your first run, updating and uninstalling, and fixes for the usual install problems.
pages.ogTitle: Install kute — the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: One binary, no cluster-side install. macOS, Linux and Windows, on x86-64 and arm64.
pages.twitterDescription: One binary, no cluster-side install. macOS, Linux and Windows.

pages.title: Verify a download — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.description: Every kute release archive is signed with a keyless cosign identity bound to the release workflow, ships an SBOM, and carries a GitHub build provenance attestation. Here is how to check all three by hand.
pages.ogTitle: Verify a download — kute, the incident console for Kubernetes
pages.ogDescription: Signed, attested, and checkable in one command — how to verify a kute download is really ours.
pages.twitterDescription: Signed, attested, and checkable in one command — how to verify a kute download is really ours.
